item.title: Every GitHub object has two IDs
item.description:
📝 We'd been using GitHub's GraphQL API, which returns node IDs like PRRC_kwDOL4aMSs6Tkzl8. GitHub's documentation mentioned that node IDs are base64 encoded. The database ID was just the last 32 bits of the decoded node ID.
🔗 Read more: https://www.greptile.com/blog/github-ids

item.title: We can't have nice things because of AI scrapers
item.description:
📝 In order to protect our services from becoming overloaded, we’ve made the following changes: The /metadata/lookup API endpoints (GET and POST versions) now require the caller to send an Authorization token in order for this endpoint to work. The ListenBrainz Labs API endpoints for mbid-mapping, mbid-mapping-release and mbid-mapping-explain have been removed.
